label: Shadefern
description: A deep-green fern growing only on the shaded face of standing stone, every frond swept to the cold side as if combed, its pale rachis catching what light bounces in. Marks which side of a rock is the cold side at a glance -- the stone-shade fern niche, now donor-free under its own name.
